title: Honest Intervals for Extreme Marginal Quantile Effects with Covariate-Dependent Tail Exponents
banked_reason: D0.5 below novelty floor: incremental < field, salvageable:false; math referee pass with verified citations. Standing operator decision: bank downgraded and stop.
gap_reasons: The supplied proof assembly supports matching upper and lower length orders on the declared class, and the framing contains no stale claim that a matching step remains open. The field-tier shortfall is significance: the result isolates one prescribed assignment order, one Hall exponent, and a tail minimum forced to a known boundary, without delivering a parameter-dependent account of their interaction. These are legitimate law-side restrictions, but the resulting fixed benchmark remains a narrow contribution. The cutoff 2^20000 and upper constant 2^56 provide no useful finite-sample calibration, and the package contains no reproducible computation demonstrating informative interval lengths at attainable sample sizes. The wage motivation remains prospective, while the published [He–Einmahl comparator](https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.2026.2676731) remains a source-verification item rather than an established theorem comparison. These substantive scope and supporting-evidence limits constrain the projected paper score even after competent editorial revision. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

Position this frontier against accepted-bank stat_weakoverlap_unisolvent_rate, explaining why its non-extreme response-curve rate under a global overlap tail neither supplies nor is subsumed by the present marginal conditional-Hall extreme-quantile frontier.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery delivered matching honest interval upper/lower orders n^(-16/95)(log n)^(119/95) on the original fixed Hall/assignment class; the math referee passed after both cited inequalities were source-attested. D0.5 graded the significance incremental below the mandatory field floor, with a missing bank-comparator positioning item and no practical finite-sample calibration. A subsequent unreviewed parameter-extension attempt was stopped by main under the standing operator below-floor decision; no F-stage Lean formalization or acceptance occurred.
tldr: Extremely high marginal wages can be dominated by a shrinking set of background profiles where education is least supported. The benchmark combines a quadratic minimum of the conditional tail exponent with a known quadratic loss of treatment information. On the bespoke original conditional Hall class, the kernel proves the exact finite-sample honest expected-length frontier R_n=n^{-16/95}(log n)^{119/95}, constructs an observable multiscale interval attaining it without a log-log loss, and proves a same-class all-procedure converse through legal observed-law alternatives. The intended contribution is at subfield tier.
gap: Common-index causal extrapolation and scalar honest-tail inference do not settle a marginal inverse whose influential covariate region changes with tail depth while observed treatment information vanishes in that region. Heterogeneous average-tail asymptotics establish the relevance of mixture concentration but do not supply the requested finite-sample causal certificate.
fill: The lower witness preserves complete conditional bodies and uses the exact observed-law likelihood. The attainment question starts from raw-indicator corrections and signed spatial moment matching, and requires a single public-constant certificate and a matching all-procedure length bound.
